note: Phase 4 fixtures (PLAN.md §13): ten loop origins across the pilot area, each at three durations. Chosen to span the situations that break loop construction differently — waterfront origins lose half their annulus to the river, park-adjacent origins have an obvious anchor in one direction only, and dense-grid origins have too many equally good choices. Ratings are for after you've walked one.
